description: Automatic copy of the Insight backup bundle: daily, before every migrate, before a restore, and before bulk changes. Restore or download from Insight > Backup.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
scheduled
pre_migrate
post_migrate
pre_restore
pre_change
manual

fields.label: Pinned
fields.description: Pinned snapshots are never removed by the retention clean-up.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: SHA-256 of the data. Two snapshots with the same fingerprint hold identical data.

fields.label: Sections
fields.description: Blank = everything. Otherwise the doctypes this snapshot covers (JSON list).

fields.label: Alert
fields.description: Set when record counts fell sharply compared with the previous snapshot — the early warning for data that disappeared.

fields.label: Index
fields.description: Small lookups (e.g. allocation entries per rule) so recovery screens can find the right snapshot without unpacking every one.

name: Insight Backup Snapshot
